title: X-Men
subtitle: Starting points & key stories
intro: Classic team milestones and modern entry points. These highlights are not a complete crossover checklist.

starts.label: Classic team
starts.description: Start with the new roster in 1975.

teammodern.label: Comic Book Herald · X-Men reading order

hox.label: Marvel · House of X / Powers of X reading order

stories.title: Second Genesis
stories.match: Choose either collection; both contain Giant-Size #1 and the early new-team issues.

stories.title: The Dark Phoenix Saga
stories.match: The Milestones volume contains the saga; Fate of the Phoenix also includes later issues. Choose one.

stories.title: Days of Future Past
stories.why: A compact classic with a future timeline.
stories.match: Both include #141–142. Doomsday is a later prequel, not a substitute.

stories.title: God Loves, Man Kills
stories.why: A contained introduction to the team’s central conflict.
stories.match: The Epic Collection includes the graphic novel as well as surrounding team stories.

stories.title: Mutant Massacre
stories.why: A major crossover; read after meeting the classic cast.
stories.match: The dedicated Epic is a collection match. Read its internal crossover order; the issue label here identifies the core team chapters.

stories.title: Age of Apocalypse
stories.issues: X-Men Alpha; the Age of Apocalypse series; X-Men Omega
stories.match: These are consecutive Alpha → Reign → Omega volumes, not alternative editions. Read all three for this collected sequence.

stories.title: New X-Men: E Is for Extinction
stories.match: Choose the short first volume or the larger Epic (#114–126).

stories.title: Astonishing X-Men: Gifted
stories.match: Choose Vol.1 for #1–6 or the Modern Era Epic for #1–12.

stories.title: House of X / Powers of X
stories.issues: House of X #1–6; Powers of X #1–6
stories.why: The doorway into the Krakoa era.
stories.match: Read the interwoven order in the collected edition; these are parallel miniseries, not two sequential blocks.
